chunks: (And God) said: "Away! Whosoever of them follows you will surely have Hell with you as requital -- an ample recompense."
ai.seo_question: What is the meaning of 'Jaza'an Mawfuran' in the context of Hell's recompense?
ai.summary: In this verse from Surah Al-Isra (17:80), God commands the disbelievers to enter Hell, specifying that it is the recompense for those who followed them, highlighting the concept of collective accountability in Shia exegesis. The phrase 'jazā'an mawfūran' (a full recompense) underscores that the punishment is not only complete but also proportionate to the degree of their misguidance and adherence to false leaders. This verse is often cited to illustrate the spiritual consequence of blind following (taqlid) of the misguided.
